explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 61 configurations over 8 sweeps (topology-ep, batch-tokens, prefill-chunking, kv-capacity, moe-collective, drafting, routing-prefix-cache, cudagraph), each at 3 load levels, every run on exactly 32 GPUs.
8x TP4 + EP (batch tokens 32,768), from the batch-tokens sweep, reached 63.28 tok/s/accelerator (2024.9 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 128 while holding the scenario's SLOs.
8x TP4 + EP (batch tokens 32,768) at concurrency 128. 108 of 183 runs held the SLOs.

meta: deterministic sweep — no LLM in the measurement path
recommendation_prose: The table below ranks the measured operating points by output tok/s per accelerator, the objective this experiment selects on, among runs that held the scenario's SLOs.

prose: Mid-width tp4 instances should win at the SLO, and EP should matter little at dp 1 but cost throughput once dp spreads experts wider.
Measured: best was 8x TP4 + EP at 60.18 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: topology-ep

prose: The per-step token cap should bind harder on four wide instances than on eight narrow ones, since long agentic prompts concentrate per instance.
Measured: best was 8x TP4 + EP (batch tokens 32,768) at 63.28 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: batch-tokens

prose: Capping prefill chunks should cost throughput at both widths, more where fewer decodes share each instance's token budget.
Measured: best was 8x TP4 + EP at 31 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: prefill-chunking

prose: nvfp4 KV and a higher memory fraction both buy cache, so on a prefix-heavy replay they should substitute rather than add.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP (KV dtype nvfp4_ds_mla) at 30.87 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: kv-capacity

prose: A DeepEP backend should beat the allgather default at EP 16, and the gap should shrink or flip at EP 4.
Measured: best was 8x TP4 + EP at 60.18 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: moe-collective

prose: dspark should raise throughput more on narrow instances, while K=5 may push wide shapes past the 20ms ITL floor.
Measured: best was 8x TP4 + EP (5 draft tokens) at 31.8 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: drafting

prose: Prefix-affinity with caching on should lead and random with caching off trail, and the gap should widen from four instances to eight.
Measured: best was 8x TP4 + EP (prefix-affinity routing) at 59.41 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: routing-prefix-cache

prose: Full capture should edge out the PIECEWISE default by a few percent.
Measured: best was 8x TP4 + EP (graph capture full decode only) at 61.31 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: cudagraph
